_comment: dependency-gate allowlist. Foundational deps only — near-zero supply-chain ambiguity for this numeric engine. Anything NOT here needs an audit doc at docs/dep_audits/<pkg>.md. The gate reads the 'allow' array; '_'-prefixed keys are ignored.
_why_these: numpy/scipy = the in-house Dixon-Coles engine's only runtime math deps; pandas = dataframe IO for the validated ingest; pytest = test runner. statsmodels (oracle O4 dev-dep) is deliberately NOT here — it enters via an audit doc to dogfood the gate.
